hypothesis: Disabling llama.cpp CPU weight repacking will eliminate the 9,180 MiB repack allocation and may restore batch-1 versus batch-8 numerical parity by routing both autoregressive and speculative verification through the raw Q4_K kernels. The speed result is unknown and must be measured rather than inferred.

frozen_change.only_runtime_change: append --no-repack to both target-only and DFlash2 server commands

decision_rules.retain_for_exact_n8_kernel: Retain if memory and parity pass and DFlash2 reaches all diagnostic-retention thresholds.
decision_rules.retain_for_memory_only: If memory and parity pass but speed fails, retain --no-repack only as evidence that a custom exact n=8 kernel must avoid the stock repack allocation.
decision_rules.reject: Reject no-repack as a solution if parity still fails or the memory gate fails.

stop_rules: Run exactly the same three prompts once for target-only and DFlash2.
Do not change draft width, quantization, prompts, or sampling in this run.
Do not enter the six-rotation performance gate automatically.
artifact_residency: Raw responses and logs remain on quant; synchronize only compact reviewed receipts and hashes.
claim_boundary: Focused memory and greedy-parity follow-up only; no quality, final-node, 100 tok/s, or novelty claim.
